speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m nwanyị, ị ma na anaghị m arịa ọrịa ngwa ngwa.
englishText: My daughter, you know I rarely get sick.
statement: Dad says he rarely gets sick.
falseStatement: Dad says he often gets sick.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ana m elekọta ahike m nke ọma.
englishText: I take very good care of my health.
statement: Dad says he takes very good care of his health.
falseStatement: Dad says he takes poor care of his health.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Kedu mgbe ikpeazụ ị gara ụlọ ọgwụ?
englishText: When was the last time you went to the hospital?
statement: The daughter asks when he last went to the hospital.
falseStatement: The daughter asks when he last went to the clinic.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says it was more than a year ago.
falseStatement: Dad says it was less than a year ago.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks if that is true.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ee. Anaghị m ahụ ụtọ isi ụlọ ọgwụ.
englishText: Yes. I don't like the smell of hospitals!
statement: Dad says he does not like the smell of hospitals.
falseStatement: Dad says he likes the smell of hospitals.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Na-achị ọchị) Ị na-ahụ dibịa ma ọ bụ onye nlezi mgbe ọ bụla?
englishText: (laughs) Do you ever see a doctor or nurse?
statement: The daughter asks whether he ever sees a doctor or nurse.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he never sees a doctor or nurse.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says he only goes when necessary.
falseStatement: Dad says he always goes when necessary.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Ị naghị enwe isi mgbu, ahụ ọkụ, ma ọ bụ ụkwara?
englishText: You don't get headaches, fever, or coughs?
statement: The daughter asks if he gets headaches, fever, or coughs.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he never gets headaches, fever, or coughs.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Enweghị m mgbu n'ahụ m, aka m, ma ọ bụ ukwu m.
englishText: No. I have no pain in my body, hand, or leg.
statement: Dad says he has no pain in his body, hand, or leg.
falseStatement: Dad says he has pain in his body, hand, or leg.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ bụ ya mere anaghị m achọ ọgwụ, anaghịkwa m arịa ọrịa!
englishText: That's why I don't need medicine and don't get sick!
statement: Dad says that is why he does not need medicine and does not get sick.
falseStatement: Dad says that is why he needs medicine and gets sick.
